---
title: "M6 - Recommendation Systems"
---

## Overview

Module M6 is a recommender component that can be exposed as OpenAPI or MCP service and used by language-model-driven interfaces. It currently targets Wikipedia edit recommendation with domain extension capability through additional training sets.
